_about: Oprox parity (R7). intel_sample is an ILLUSTRATIVE SAMPLE: payer-level approval rates, denial reasons by payer, comparable-case cards, appeal analogues and override patterns that the Authorizations and Denial Intelligence screens show next to the clinic's own records. It is demo data, not Harvest's history and not a prediction; every screen that shows a number from it says so and marks it Simulated. The clinic's own counts (decisions logged, suggestions included or dismissed) are computed live from state.rec_decisions and added to the sample baseline (web/js/shared/intel.js). rate_usd_per_unit is a demo assumption used only for the 'at risk' dollar figures.

intel_sample.basis: Illustrative sample from the demo data. It is not Harvest's own history and it is not a prediction.
intel_sample.rate_basis: Demo assumption: $205 for one IOP unit. Replace it with the contracted rate before the dollar figures are used for anything.
